reasons.plausibility: The precipitation strengthening approach via two-stage aging is well-established in Ni-based alloys and logically extends to Ti-Ni high-entropy systems, making it scientifically plausible.
reasons.testability: It outlines a straightforward comparison of aged versus as-cast samples with clear structural and mechanical metrics for falsification, enabling a conclusive test.
reasons.usefulness: This targeted heat treatment strategy and its straightforward experimental verification can significantly guide researchers seeking to enhance the elevated-temperature performance of Ti-Ni HEAs.
